clips.text: Nvidia's CEO has resigned, after thirty-three years in charge. Here's what is actually confirmed.
On November twelfth, Nvidia said he stepped down as CEO and left the board, effective immediately.
Days earlier, he admitted to his staff that he had been unfaithful to his wife.
The board is also investigating reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Nothing is proven.
Nvidia's finance chief is now interim CEO, and the shares fell over fourteen percent at one point.
